    About Sui

    Sui is a layer-1 blockchain that uses the Move programming language and an object-centric data model to process many transactions in parallel. SUI pays gas and is used for staking.

    Where this SUI price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (SUI-USD), Binance (SUI/USDT) and Kraken (SUI/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 3.57B SUI (supply last updated November 3, 2026).
